findings.description: Acceptance criteria specifies 'KYRO001' format (exactly two zeros), but code accepts whatever order.reference_number contains. No validation or formatting enforces the pattern. Backend must ensure format compliance.

findings.issue: WhatsApp button hidden when reference missing
findings.description: Order cards without a reference number don't show the WhatsApp button at all. The acceptance criteria request states this should redirect from modal to payment page if unavailable on order card, but current implementation just hides the button. Verify expected behavior when reference number is absent.
